responsibility: This file implements gm2’s pretty-printer for GCC tree and gimple-like structures, rendering frontend IR back into a Modula-2-flavored textual form for debugging and dump output. It walks function declarations, blocks, statements, expressions, declarations, and types; manages indentation and output state; emits pre- and post-genericize dump streams; consults M2Options and M2LangDump_IsDumpRequiredTree to decide when to print; and also provides a file-descriptor dump path, making it the module’s main human-readable IR dumping engine rather than a transformation or lowering pass.
same_name_distinction: Implementation unit for the m2pp interface: unlike m2pp.h, which only publishes the C/C++ API and dump-kind enum, and m2pp.def, which exposes a reduced Modula-2 foreign interface, this .cc file contains the actual tree-walking pretty-printer logic plus the concrete dump-file and fd-handling code.
